## What you did
- Prod blue/green Terraform for the PG17 cutover is ready: the replica now follows the blue/green instead of being replaced, and the plan shows 2 changes, 0 destroys [1].
- The rehearsal on a snapshot clone showed 74 s of write downtime. You tore the clone down afterwards [1].
- You opened PR #321 with Maya as reviewer [1].

## What changed
- Maya approved #321: the Terraform is right, and the replica fix is a good catch. She asked that it not be merged before Fernhill confirms the window [3].

## What is still open
- Fernhill's month-end batch moved the cutover to Sunday 22/11, 02:00–04:00 UTC [8]. The runbook and the Notion page still say Saturday 21/11 [1][10]. Once the runbook is updated, #321 can be merged [3][8].
- Lior wants 30 minutes' notice before the switchover so he can pause the ingest consumers [9]. Daniel is on call for the API side on Sunday and wants a ping when you start the switchover [7].
- The rollback rehearsal on a fresh clone is still a TODO in the runbook, planned for Thursday 19/11 [1]. After switchover the old instance gets no writes, so rolling back is not a simple switch [1].
